desc:
🍄 Forage wild mushrooms, grow your garden, and uncover the secrets of the oldest grove! 🍄

🧪 EARLY ALPHA: the game is still being built, so you WILL run into bugs, rough edges and balance changes. Things may change a lot between updates. Thank you for helping us test!

🌿 Explore 7 cozy areas, from the sunny Mushroom Meadow to the mysterious Ancient Grove
🔍 Discover 50+ mushroom species, including secret ones hidden behind riddles
🏡 Plant your finds, collect Spores and grow your garden all the way to your own Mushroom Cottage
🐞 Ride bugs, befriend little companions and dress up you and your garden
📖 Fill your Collection Book and help Professor Morel with his research
🌙 Day and night, rain, full moons and world events change what grows

🐛 Found a bug or have an idea? Use the Feedback button in-game. We read every report!

💚 Made with love by Clovermoon Games
